dedupe_keys.name: регистър на язовирите общинска собственост в община струмяни

description: Регистър на язовирите общинска собственост в община Струмяни is a dataset listed in Open Data Bulgaria, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Стоян Стоянов. Register of dams on the territory of the municipality of Strumyani, which are municipal property. In fact, these are ponds, but according to the classification of the State Agency for Metrological and Technical Supervision, all such facilities are dams. Coverage: Стоян Стоянов. The portal shows the English title as "Register of municipal dams in the municipality of Strumyani" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Стоян Стоянов. Its keywords include язовири, регистър на язовирите. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-bulgaria.
